events.body:
## Context

BLT-Autopatch (`blt-autopatch/`) is rated **Bronze** on [Waypoint](https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/?q=blt-autopatch): it meets 57% of the checklist that applies to it. Waypoint rates every BLT project daily against the same checklist (`blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py`): **bronze** is the basics, **silver** means it runs, **gold** means it is looked after. This issue lists what is left for gold.

## What to do

### Bronze (the basics: a README, a description, a licence and a logo)

- **README explains the project.** Write a README.md of at least 1000 characters: what the project is, who it is for, its live site and where to report issues.
- **One-line description.** Add `.forkmesh/info.json` to the folder with a one-line `description` (and `website` if it has one), so Waypoint and the forge can show what the project is.
- **Licence file.** Add a LICENSE file to the folder (most BLT projects are AGPL-3.0; copy the repository root's LICENSE).

### Silver (it runs: tests in CI, an automatic deploy, a live site and steps to run it)

- **Tests run in CI.** Add automated tests and a row for the folder in `scripts/ci/tests.tsv`, so every pull request runs them (`scripts/ci/test.sh blt-autopatch`).
- **README shows how to run it.** Add a "Run locally" (or Install / Getting started) section to the README with the exact commands in a code block, including how to run the tests.

### Gold (it is looked after: the BLT theme, a contributing guide, recent commits, several contributors and triaged issues)

- **Contributing guide.** Add CONTRIBUTING.md (or a Contributing section in the README): how to set up, test, and open a pull request on git.owaspblt.org, linking the root CONTRIBUTING.md and AI_POLICY.md.

## Notes

- The project is still a placeholder: no code and no tests yet. Start with a minimal Worker or script and a test, then list it in `scripts/ci/tests.tsv`.
- The README's Source Code link still points at the old separate repository; point it at https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/tree/main/blt-autopatch.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] README explains the project
- [ ] One-line description
- [ ] Licence file
- [ ] Tests run in CI
- [ ] README shows how to run it
- [ ] Contributing guide
- [ ] Waypoint shows `blt-autopatch` as Gold after the next daily refresh

## How to test locally

```bash
curl -s https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/forge_data.json -o /tmp/forge_data.json
python3 blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py /tmp/forge_data.json --report | grep -w blt-autopatch
scripts/ci/test.sh <your folder>
```

The report reads your checkout, so it shows the new rating before the change is merged.
